replacements.new: - [x] Define measurable representation-change quantities during learning that do not depend on neural architecture names. — ✅ `gmi-833-ae-ae9-transition-markers-v1` D-AE9/AE9-1/AE9-2: The six registered markers CELLS, REFINEMENT, SEPARABILITY, INVARIANCE, READOUT_ARITY and USABLE are defined as functions of the induced partition ker(phi) and the registered readout class (junta arity 2, tree depth 2) alone, never of an architecture, layer or parameter count: the GF2_ELIMINATION and GREEDY_DECISION_LIST learners induce the same partition and return exactly equal marker values (CELLS 2, INVARIANCE 4, READOUT_ARITY 2, SEPARABILITY 1, USABLE 1), an arbitrary injective re-encoding of the code set leaves every marker exactly unchanged at normalized partition distance 0, and all 15 pairs of distinct registered partitions are separated with normalized partition distance strictly above 0.
